C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION-RECOVERY.Architecture: The new Export preferences tab reuses the current form sections, controls, presets, slot strips and factory values. It shows both page geometry and HTML-title defaults rather than selecting one export format. It has Reset and immediate apply, no Export/OK button and no dialog shell. Preserve the mark-last-print-options appearance schema and REMEMBER_EXPORT_OPTIONS filtering. A separate mark-export-page-options localStorage record holds the five formerly per-flow fields as explicit future-export defaults: pageSize, pageSizeWidth, pageSizeHeight, isLandscape and htmlTitle. This deliberate plan proposal makes every relocated control effective while preserving legacy appearance payloads. The HTML-title default is only used for styled HTML; an empty default retains the existing document-title behavior. No document-derived title is persisted automatically.
C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION-RECOVERY.Interfaces: util/exportPageDefaults.js exports DEFAULT_EXPORT_PAGE_OPTIONS(), getRememberedExportPageOptions() and rememberExportPageOptions(options). Factory values are A4, 210, 297, false and empty HTML title. Accept the existing seven size values A3/A4/A5/Legal/Letter/Tabloid/custom; finite custom dimensions stay within the existing 10..2000 mm control bounds; orientation must be boolean and HTML title string. Malformed, null, array and missing fields fall back independently. Keep a same-realm memory fallback for unavailable storage and expose write success to the section so a failed cross-window save cannot look durably applied. store/editor.js keeps getRememberedExportAppearance() but refreshes guarded persisted appearance at dispatch time instead of relying solely on module initialization. EXPORT_DOCUMENT(type) snapshots appearance plus page defaults for pdf/styledHtml/docx into the existing bus export shape; EXPORT_DOCX_DOCUMENT delegates for compatibility. Forward the same captured Word options through the already-supported internal pageOptions field to _EXPORT_DOCX; never reread mutable defaults after the save dialog. PRINT_DOCUMENT retains type print, appearance-only options and native-panel geometry.
C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION-RECOVERY.SettingsNavigation: util/exportSettingsNavigation.js exports openExportSettings(): write the existing settings.lastTab value export through the tab catalog helper, then call the existing projectStore.OPEN_SETTING_WINDOW action. Add export as the first catalog tab with a matching icon in the existing 22-pixel scaffold, route /preference/export, name export and localized preferences.tabs.export. The Settings shell watches valid storage changes of its existing last-tab key and routes an already-open window; a new window uses the existing root redirect. Ignore other keys, null and invalid tab values; remove the listener on unmount. No backend command, new IPC event or capability is introduced. If storage is unavailable, open Settings and keep Export as its first visible tab, matching the specification fallback; report an actual settings-write failure rather than pretending cross-window persistence succeeded.

T-001.Title: Relocate the form into immediate-apply Export preferences with coherent remembered defaults

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Write failing-first storage/default and mounted-form regressions. Legacy appearance data hydrates all original appearance fields and optional toggles. Separate page defaults preserve chosen size, dimensions, orientation and explicit HTML title through remount and a fresh module realm. Invalid values fall back independently; reads and writes cannot throw into the UI.

Move the three dialog suites to the exact prefComponents destinations, retaining meaningful hydration, presets, custom-margin detours, header/footer type derivation, font/style toggles and Reset assertions. Replace obsolete dialog/listener assertions with immediate-apply, no Export button and no export-dispatch assertions. Every control, including numeric input v-model changes, commits valid state. Removing an optional block removes its previously remembered keys.

Add the Export catalog entry, icon and route. Apply existing Preferences tokens in its real shell; preserve light/dark and standard control behavior. Reset restores and remembers the full factory baseline without exporting. Preserve existing appearance storage semantics and keep HTML title separate from appearance.

Refresh appearance reads and implement EXPORT_DOCUMENT with an immutable operation snapshot. The Word pipeline receives the same captured page/appearance options even if settings change before Save resolves. PRINT_DOCUMENT retains its native panel and appearance-only payload. Failure to persist from Settings is visible; no successful cross-window durability claim is inferred from a memory-only fallback.

T-002.Title: Dispatch every export directly to Save and remove the modal surface

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Make file.export-file-pdf and file.export-file-html call the snapshotting store action. Retain the Word compatibility entry. Menu, tab-menu and titlebar popover reach the same action without a settings modal; popover visuals and document activation guards remain unchanged.

Remove the dialog mount/import from pages/app.vue and delete its old shell after the three suites migrate. Retain reusable exportOptions and headerFooterStrip modules. Remove showExportDialog producers, handlers and obsolete comments in live source; preserve the existing bus export keys and renderer/backend payload contracts.

Pin Save-dialog cancellation, empty/current/background-document guards and complete payloads for all formats. Capture pre-change default-option semantic output in isolated fixtures, then prove unchanged HTML content/styles/assets, PDF page options and Word geometry/content for the same options. No new backend command or exporter rewrite is in scope.

T-003.Title: Route all export notices to Export preferences and complete locale parity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add openExportSettings and the owned Settings-shell storage listener. Test the existing last-tab key, valid export navigation, listener cleanup, newly created and already-open windows, same-tab requests, invalid keys/values and blocked storage. Use the existing OPEN_SETTING_WINDOW action without changing its backend.

Retarget the existing Word quiet action and add the same quiet action to successful PDF/HTML notices through APPLY_EXPORT_SUCCESS. Reveal actions, cancelled exports and error notifications retain their behavior. The notice action never dispatches an export.

Add preferences.tabs.export and any genuinely needed section/status text in all ten existing locale JSON files. Remove only keys proved unused after dialog removal; retain pdfTitle/docxTitle and any live save-dialog labels. The repository has ten locale originals and no generated min twins; do not invent new locale artifacts.
